simple.meaning: תַּעֲלוּל (taʻălûwl) is a Hebrew word meaning “caprice (as a fit coming on ), i.e. vexation ; concretely a tyrant.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּעֲלוּל (H8586) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 3:4, with occurrences in Isaiah.

simple.summary: תַּעֲלוּל (taʻălûwl) / H8586 is traced through Isaiah 3:4, Isaiah 66:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

II. עלל (√ of following; possibly = I. עלל (Kö ii. 1, 106 ) whence child as capricious, mischievous , but dubious; > following from עוּל ; in either case original meaning quite forgotten; probably distinct √, meaning unknown).
